About the Scholarship

MISEI is an Erasmus Mundus master in inclusive education sciences, training specialists who design and lead inclusive schooling systems. Its application period runs from October 2026 to 1 February 2027, with Erasmus Mundus scholarships available for the 2027 cohort.

MISEI is an Erasmus Mundus master in inclusive education sciences, training specialists who design and lead inclusive schooling systems. Its application period runs from October 2026 to 1 February 2027, with Erasmus Mundus scholarships available for the 2027 cohort.

Programme Highlights

  • Specialised inclusive-education curriculum across European partner universities
  • Application window October 2026 – 1 February 2027
  • Scholarship round tied to the February deadline
  • Graduates work in inclusive-education policy, school leadership and specialised teaching

Who Should Apply

Education graduates, teachers and inclusion specialists are the core audience; classroom experience and a clear inclusion-focused motivation strengthen applications.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the MISEI application page during the October-February window and flag scholarship interest in the form. Key deadline information: 1 February 2027 (application period October 2026 – February 2027).

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About MISEI Consortium

The MISEI consortium delivers the International Master in Inclusive Education Sciences as an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master with European partner universities focused on inclusive schooling.

Official website: https://master-misei.com

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
